events.verdict: Mejri (DAL) and Randle (LAL) briefly engage and separate during rebounding.
Mejri (DAL) grabs ad holds Caldwell-Pope (LAL), affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Randle (LAL) makes marginal contact with McDermott (DAL) that does not affect his FOM.
Thomas (LAL) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Mejri (DAL) that affects his driving shot attempt.
Kuzma (LAL) and Ferrell (DAL) make incidental contact with each other during rebounding.
Ferrell (DAL) legally contests Kuzma's (LAL) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Randle (LAL) and Mejri (DAL) briefly engage and separate after the made basket.
LHH shows Randle (LAL) does not maintain verticality, bringing his arm down and making contact to Kleber's (DAL) arm on the made dunk.
Kuzma (LAL) sets the screen on Ferrell (DAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Ferrell (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Thomas (LAL) during his drive to the basket.
Randle (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position on McDermott (DAL) during his drive to the basket.
Kuzma (LAL) makes marginal contact with Mejri (DAL) that does not affect his shot attempt.
Kleber (DAL) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Randle (LAL) that does not affect his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Kleber (DAL) does not bring his hand underneath the ball and bring it to a pause.
Mejri (DAL) and Ingram (LAL) make incidental contact with each other during rebounding.
Thomas (LAL) commits a take foul on Ferrell (DAL).
Mejri (DAL) briefly grabs and releases Randle's (LAL) jersey, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Randle (LAL) commits a take foul on Smith Jr. (DAL).
McDermott (DAL) makes incidental contact with Caldwell-Pope (LAL) that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Kleber (DAL) and Kuzma (LAL) briefly engage and separate during rebounding.
